```python
import re

def is_valid_email(email: str) -> bool:
    pattern = r'^[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}$'
    return bool(re.match(pattern, email))
```

Usage: `is_valid_email("<email>")` → `True`

Note: this covers common cases, not full RFC 5322 compliance (no quoted strings, IP literals, etc.).
